cap: Perineal tears are graded by the deepest structure torn. A first-degree tear involves vaginal mucosa or perineal skin, a second-degree tear the muscles of the perineal body, a third-degree tear the external anal sphincter, partly or completely, and a fourth-degree tear also the rectal mucosa. Third- and fourth-degree tears risk fecal incontinence, and fourth-degree tears risk a rectovaginal fistula, so careful layered repair matters.
